1.name: Digital Stethoscope
1.description: High-precision digital stethoscope with Bluetooth connectivity for real-time diagnostics. Features advanced noise cancellation and recording capabilities.

2.name: Surgical Scissors Set
2.description: Premium stainless steel surgical scissors set including Mayo, Metzenbaum, and iris scissors. Autoclavable and corrosion-resistant.

3.name: N95 Respirator Masks
3.description: NIOSH-approved N95 respirator masks. Box of 100 units. High filtration efficiency and comfortable fit for extended wear.

4.name: Blood Pressure Monitor
4.description: Automatic digital blood pressure monitor with large LCD display. Includes memory storage for 120 readings and irregular heartbeat detection.

5.name: Disposable Gloves (Latex)
5.description: Powder-free latex examination gloves. Box of 500 units. Ambidextrous design with textured fingertips for enhanced grip.

6.name: Infrared Thermometer
6.description: Non-contact infrared thermometer with instant reading. Measures body, surface, and room temperature with high accuracy.

7.name: Wheelchair - Standard
7.description: Standard manual wheelchair with padded armrests and footrests. Foldable design for easy transport and storage.

8.name: Pulse Oximeter
8.description: Fingertip pulse oximeter with LED display showing SpO2 and pulse rate. Portable and battery-powered with auto-shutoff.

9.name: Surgical Face Masks
9.description: Type IIR surgical face masks with high bacterial filtration efficiency. Fluid-resistant and latex-free. Box of 50 units.

10.name: Disposable Syringes
10.description: 3ml disposable syringes with needle. Sterile, single-use, and latex-free. Box of 100 units with clear barrel for easy measurement.

11.name: ECG Machine - 12 Lead
11.description: Professional 12-lead ECG machine with digital display and thermal printer. Includes interpretation software and data storage.

12.name: IV Stand (Adjustable)
12.description: Height-adjustable IV stand with 4-hook top. Chrome-plated steel with stable base and smooth-rolling casters.

13.name: Laboratory Centrifuge
13.description: High-speed laboratory centrifuge with digital controls. 12-tube capacity with safety lid lock and automatic imbalance detection.

14.name: Microscope - Binocular
14.description: Professional binocular microscope with LED illumination. 40x to 1000x magnification range with coaxial coarse/fine focus.

15.name: Hospital Bed - Electric
15.description: Electric hospital bed with adjustable height and backrest. Includes side rails and mattress. Remote control operation.

16.name: Walking Frame (Zimmer)
16.description: Lightweight aluminum walking frame with rubber ferrules. Height adjustable with ergonomic hand grips for maximum comfort.

17.name: Autoclave Sterilizer
17.description: 23L capacity steam autoclave sterilizer with digital display. Automatic temperature and pressure control with multiple cycle options.

18.name: Surgical Gowns (Disposable)
18.description: Level 3 disposable isolation gowns. Fluid-resistant with elastic cuffs and tie closures. Box of 50 units.

19.name: Nebulizer Machine
19.description: Compressor nebulizer for respiratory therapy. Quiet operation with adjustable flow rate and complete mask set included.

20.name: Blood Collection Tubes
20.description: EDTA vacuum blood collection tubes. Sterile and latex-free. Box of 100 tubes with purple cap for hematology testing.
